subject: mathematics
title: Grade 7 Mathematics
description: Rational numbers, algebra, geometry, and data handling

questions.question: What is the sum of angles in a triangle?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

questions.question: If the ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3:2 and there are 30 students total, how many girls are there?
What is the simple interest on ₹1000 at 5% per annum for 2 years?
What is the value of 2³ × 2²?
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2³ × 2² = 2^(3+2) = 2⁵.

questions.question: Find the median of: 3, 7, 2, 9, 5.
questions.explanation: Arranged in order: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. The median (middle value) is 5.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cube with side 4 cm?
Which algebraic expression represents 'twice a number decreased by 5'?
questions.explanation: 'Twice a number' = 2x. 'Decreased by 5' means subtract 5. So: 2x - 5.

questions.question: Two supplementary angles have one angle of 65°. What is the other angle?
Evaluate: 5 + 3 × (8 - 2) ÷ 2
questions.explanation: BODMAS: brackets first (8-2)=6, then 3×6=18, then 18÷2=9, then 5+9=14.

questions.question: A price decreased from ₹500 to ₹400. What is the percentage decrease?
What is the LCM of 8 and 12?
What type of triangle has all three sides equal?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has all three sides equal and all three angles equal to 60°.

questions.question: What is the mode of: 4, 2, 4, 7, 3, 4, 2?
questions.explanation: Mode is the value that appears most often. 4 appears 3 times, more than any other number.
